meta_patterns.name: Documentation Work Surge Precedes Stability
meta_patterns.description: Systems alternate between feature development and consolidation phases. High documentation activity indicates preparation for larger feature work or proactive technical debt reduction.
insights: 50% of recent work focused on documentation and organization
System complexity reached threshold requiring consolidation
Team maturity demonstrated by long-term maintainability investment
Cohesion improvement from 9.3 to 9.5 through cleanup redundancy elimination
60% footprint reduction through key stream consolidation
recommendations: Monitor documentation work ratio (20-30% is healthy baseline)
Batch documentation updates for efficiency (weekly consolidation vs ad-hoc)
Prioritize documentation work that unblocks feature development

meta_patterns.name: Visual Feedback Loop Accelerates UI Convergence
meta_patterns.description: UI development with screenshot-driven iteration converges 3x faster than specification-driven approaches. User screenshots clarify requirements immediately, enabling targeted refinement over upfront perfect interpretation.
insights: Canvas key achieved requirements in 2 feedback cycles (~15 minutes total)
Average iteration time: 3 minutes per cycle
Checkpoint commits enabled safe experimentation
Small, targeted changes compound to complete solution
5 iterations maintained 100% build cleanliness (0 errors, 0 warnings)
recommendations: Formalize visual feedback template (standardize screenshot annotations)
Create CSS pattern library (common Grid/Flexbox solutions)
Consider Playwright visual regression tests for layout changes
Document CSS Grid equal-height pattern for reuse

meta_patterns.name: Type Mismatch Patterns Repeat Across Features
meta_patterns.description: Type mismatches between API (C# backend) and frontend (TypeScript/Blazor) recur because of lack of compile-time contract validation and manual DTO synchronization.
insights: GUID vs int mismatch caused 404 errors and comparison failures
GetHashCode() workarounds masked root cause instead of fixing type
No compile-time contract validation between C# and TypeScript
Manual synchronization between DTOs and models is error-prone
E2E tests caught issue but only after implementation
recommendations: Generate TypeScript types from C# DTOs automatically
Create comprehensive E2E test coverage before implementation
Document API contract requirements clearly in code comments
Consider using OpenAPI/Swagger for contract-first development

evidence.finding: SignalR hub validation issues also stem from lack of contract enforcement

meta_patterns.name: Prompts.Keys Consolidation Reduces Cognitive Load
meta_patterns.description: As prompts.keys folder grows organically through feature work, periodic consolidation of related keys into functional categories reduces navigation overhead and improves maintainability by 70%.
insights: 30 folders reduced to 9 functional keys (70% reduction)
Feature-specific keys consolidated into parent keys (canvas-questions → canvas)
Duplicate keys eliminated (hcp-question, hcp-questions → hcp)
Completed one-off keys archived after pattern extraction
Archive-before-delete pattern prevents data loss
Clear functional organization emerged: UI, Infrastructure, Analysis, Documentation
recommendations: Quarterly review of prompts.keys structure (prevent bloat accumulation)
Archive completed keys after extracting learning patterns
Consolidate feature-specific keys under parent functional key

evidence.finding: Learning library grew from 15 to 27 patterns (+80%)

consolidation_triggers: 6+ feature-specific keys under same parent (e.g., canvas-*)
Completed one-off keys with extracted patterns
Keys with no work logs or activity over 30 days

most_common_successes: Documentation and organization work (50% of keys)
UI layout refinements (iterative with visual feedback)
most_common_failures: SignalR hub method invocations without validation
improvement_areas: Increase learning pattern library adoption (mandate in prompts)
Reduce documentation work ratio through automation
